Name: Safe Return Scepter - Double Click Activation Protection
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Safe Return Scepter[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=3][b]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements
[/url]﻿[/size][/center]

[b]Tired of accidentally warping to your front door while clearing weeds?

[/b]We've all been there. You are busy clearing debris or harvesting crops, you accidentally scroll one slot too far to your Return Scepter, click, and—poof—you are staring at a loading screen, standing at your front door, confused.

[b]Safe Return Scepter[/b] is a simple, lightweight quality-of-life mod that fixes this by requiring a [b]double-click[/b] to activate the Return Scepter.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40921/40921-1767679072-1719388409.png[/img]

[b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Double-Click Safety:[/b] Prevents the Return Scepter from activating on the first click. You must click twice within 0.5 seconds to warp.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Visual Feedback:[/b] A small notification ("Double-click to warp") appears on the first click so you know the mod is working
[/list][list]
[*][b]Controller Support:[/b] Works with Mouse & Keyboard and Controllers (Gamepads).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Zero Lag:[/b] Extremely lightweight code that only runs checks when you press the tool button.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40921/40921-1767679072-1556930237.png[/img]

﻿[b]Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].

[*]Download this mod.

[*]Unzip the SafeReturnScepter folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list][b]Compatibility

[/b][list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+:[/b] Fully compatible.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Works perfectly in multiplayer. This is a client-side mod, so only [b]you[/b] need to have it installed to benefit from it. It will not affect other players.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Safe to Uninstall:[/b] You can remove this mod at any time. It does not modify your save file or add custom items.
[/list][b]Configuration
[/b]
Currently, the mod is set to a [b]0.5-second[/b] window for the double-click, which feels natural for most players. No configuration is required—just install and play!
